units.source_text: 源氏公子回京以来，专心在二条院奉承紫姬，竟不曾去访问花散里，觉得很对她不起。

en.t: Since returning to the capital, Prince Genji had devoted himself entirely to attending Lady Murasaki at the Nijo mansion, and had not once gone to visit Hanachirusato, so he felt he had treated her very badly.

units.source_text: 他公事很忙，身份又高，行动不免有所顾忌。

en.t: He was very busy with official duties, and his rank was high, so he could not help being cautious about his movements.

units.source_text: 加之这花散里并无何等牵惹心目之处，因此不甚介怀。

en.t: Moreover, Hanachirusato had nothing in particular that strongly captivated his heart or eyes, so he did not think much about it.

units.source_text: 五月里淫雨连绵，公私都很空闲，寂寞无聊之时，有一天他忽然想起了她，便出门去访问。

en.t: In the fifth month, when the long rains continued and both public and private affairs left him rather idle, he suddenly remembered her one lonely, tedious day and went out to visit.

units.source_text: 源氏公子虽然疏远花散里，然而关心她的一切日常生活，花散里全靠他的照顾度日。

en.t: Although Prince Genji had kept his distance from Hanachirusato, he still cared about every detail of her daily life, and she lived entirely through his support.

units.source_text: 因此久别重逢，花散里态度仍很亲切，并无怨恨之色，源氏公子便觉安心。

en.t: So when they met again after a long separation, Hanachirusato was still very warm toward him and showed no sign of resentment, which put Prince Genji at ease.

units.source_text: 她的屋子年来更加荒芜了，住在那里想必凄凉。

en.t: Her house had grown even more desolate over the years, and living there must surely have been lonely.

units.source_text: 源氏公子先和她的姐姐丽景殿女御晤谈，到了夜深时分，才去西厅访问花散里。

en.t: Prince Genji first spoke with her elder sister, the Reikeiden Consort, and only when the night had grown late did he go to the western wing to visit Hanachirusato.

units.source_text: 天空偶然放晴，朦胧月色射入室内，把源氏公子的姿态照得十分艳丽，俊美无比。

en.t: The sky happened to clear, and hazy moonlight streamed into the room, illuminating Prince Genji so that he looked dazzlingly elegant and incomparably handsome.

units.source_text: 花散里见了不觉肃然起敬。

en.t: Seeing him, Hanachirusato could not help feeling a solemn reverence.

units.source_text: 但她原来坐在窗前眺望月色，也就从容地坐在那里接待公子，那模样甚是端详。

en.t: But she had already been sitting by the window gazing at the moonlight, so she calmly remained there to receive the prince, looking very composed and dignified.

units.source_text: 听见近旁秧鸡的叫声像敲门一样，花散里便吟诗道：

en.t: When she heard the cry of a nearby water rail sounding like someone knocking at the door, Hanachirusato recited a poem:
